Tagkin · app design

Protect what you value.

QR tags for bags, keys, gear and pets. Whoever finds something scans the tag and alerts the owner, privately. No app needed for finders.

What’s insideFinder web flow, owner app, Gift a tag, store screenshots, printed tags and marketing visuals.
Design systemFresh mint, Bricolage Grotesque and Inter, light and dark, WCAG AA contrast.
Designed bySelasey Gbeddy · Technical Product Owner
StatusDesign v1, November 2026. App in development.
